note: HGB on 19 label-free bands; top 2% of footprint; known faults zeroed. Holdout proxy only; no organizer score.
verdict_reason: Blocked before any submission slot. Format checks pass (shared template validator PASSED), but the uniqueness gate fails: 163 of 613 single-band registry rasters on the competition grid exceed the 70% dot-overlap flag (evidence/uniqueness_check.json). Strongest match: 17GEMSDOE F-ensemble-2pct (103,347 dots vs our 103,348; 75.8% of our dots within 3 px of its dots; lift 15.2 over random placement; sample rank correlation 0.507). The highest rank correlation in the registry is 0.517 (12GEMSDOE multiphysics_submission, 97.2% dot overlap). Both are below the 0.90 correlation flag but well above the value-similarity level of a unique file. Holdout proxy 0.0352 (HOLDOUT-DTI) is not an organizer score.
